data.one_liner: Flutter package for bKash payment gateway integration in Bangladesh.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to handle bKash mobile finance payments, create and pay via agreements, and process refunds or check refund statuses.
use_when: You need to integrate bKash payment gateway into a Flutter app targeting users in Bangladesh.
You require agreement-based recurring bKash payments or refunds.
avoid_when: You need international payment gateways like Stripe or global in-app purchases.
You do not have approved bKash API credentials or sandbox access.
strengths: Provides support for payments, agreements, and refund APIs.
weaknesses: Requires manual coordination with bKash for credentials and sandbox access.
Limited platform support primarily focusing on mobile use cases.
data.setup_notes: Requires bKash sales team approval for development or production access keys and credentials.
